shell.homeBody: Select a machine in the sidebar, or add one.

usage.none: No usage data. Accounts of providers with a usage endpoint (for example Claude and ChatGPT subscriptions) show their limits here.
usage.noMachines: No machines yet. Add one in the sidebar.
usage.reloginWithin: re-login within $duration (Anthropic expires OAuth grants ~30d after login)
usage.reloginNow: grant is past Anthropic's ~30d lifetime; re-login now

dock.noSession: Open a session to use this panel.
dock.noMachine: Open a session or select a machine to use this panel.

todo.empty: No todos yet. The agent's todo list shows up here.

hub.empty: No subagents yet. Agents the session starts show up here.
hub.killBody: Its running turn is aborted and the agent is released for good. It cannot be revived.
hub.noCompanion: The companion is not loaded in this session, so messaging, killing and reviving agents are unavailable.

sessionTree.label: Label…
sessionTree.summarizing: Summarizing the branch you are leaving…
sessionTree.branched: Branched into a new session. The message is back in the composer.
sessionTree.summaryBody: omp writes a summary of the abandoned branch at the new position. This makes a model call.
sessionTree.noCompanion: The companion is not loaded in this session, so going to an entry and labels are unavailable.

fileBrowser.name: Name
fileBrowser.deleteFileBody: The file is deleted from the machine.
fileBrowser.deleteFolderBody: The folder and everything in it are deleted from the machine.
fileBrowser.deleteLinkBody: The symbolic link is deleted from the machine. What it points to stays.
fileBrowser.conflictChanged: The file changed on the machine since you opened it. Overwrite it with your version, or discard your edits and reload it?
fileBrowser.conflictDeleted: The file was deleted on the machine since you opened it. Overwrite recreates it.
fileBrowser.tooLarge: Larger than $mb MB: showing the beginning, read-only.
fileBrowser.notUtf8: Not UTF-8 text: read-only, so saving cannot damage it.

machines.deleteBody: Saved passwords of this machine are deleted too. Keys and trusted host keys stay.
machines.updatingOmp: Running omp update on the machine…
machines.ompUpdated: Updated omp from $from to $to. Sessions already running keep $from until their omp exits.
machines.noHostKeys: No host key trusted yet. The first connection asks.
machines.notProbed: Connect to read the machine's OS, shell and omp.

editor.name: Name
editor.hostHelper: Host name, IP address, MagicDNS name or 100.x address
editor.noKeys: No keys on this device yet.
editor.passwordSavedHint: Leave empty to keep the saved password
editor.passwordAskHint: Leave empty to be asked when connecting
editor.jumpHostsHelp: Dialed in order before the machine. For a host behind NAT with a reverse tunnel, add the relay host here and set the machine's host to localhost and the tunnel port.
editor.proxyCommandIgnored: ProxyCommand is not supported and was ignored: $command
editor.hostKeysPretrusted: Host keys from Tailscale are trusted when you save.
editor.agentHelp: Like the ssh command: the ssh-agent's keys (IdentityAgent, else SSH_AUTH_SOCK), then the IdentityFile keys ~/.ssh/config sets for this host, else ~/.ssh/id_ed25519, id_ecdsa and id_rsa. Encrypted keys ask for their passphrase. If the host refuses every key, its password prompt follows.

keys.empty: No keys yet. Import an existing key or generate a new one.
keys.deleteBody: The private key is removed from this device.
keys.deleteUsedBy: Machines using it need another key: $machines.
keys.name: Name
keys.privateKeyHint: Paste an OpenSSH or PEM private key
keys.generatedBody: Add this public key to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on your machines.
keys.malformed: This is not a private key the app can read.
keys.unsupported: This key type is not supported.
keys.passphraseRequired: This key is encrypted. Enter its passphrase.
keys.duplicate: This key is already stored as $name.
keys.fileTooLarge: This file is too large to be a private key.

hostKey.unknownBody: First connection to $host. Compare the fingerprint with the server's key before you trust it.
hostKey.changedBody: $host presented a different key than the one trusted before. The server may have been reinstalled, or someone may be intercepting the connection.
hostKey.changedOpenSshBody: $host presented a key that differs from ~/.ssh/known_hosts. The server may have been reinstalled, or someone may be intercepting the connection.
hostKey.revokedBody: ~/.ssh/known_hosts marks the key of $host as revoked. The connection is refused.
hostKey.otherTypesBody: ~/.ssh/known_hosts knows $host only with keys of other types. The server may have added a key type, or someone may be intercepting the connection. Compare the fingerprint with the server's key before you trust it.

links.confirmBody: This is a $scheme: link, not a web page. It opens whichever app handles $scheme: links on this device.

prompt.passphraseAccepted: $hop accepts this key. Enter its passphrase to use it.
prompt.passphraseUnknownKey: Enter the passphrase to offer this key to $hop.

connectError.noKeySelected: $hop uses key authentication, but no key is selected. Edit the machine to choose one.
connectError.keyMissing: The private key for $hop is missing from this device.
connectError.hostKeyRejected: The host key of $hop was not trusted.
connectError.keyUnavailable: The key for $hop cannot be used on this device.

agentKeysRefused.one: $host did not accept the $n key in the ssh-agent.
agentKeysRefused.other: $host did not accept any of the $n keys in the ssh-agent.

connectError.keysRefused: $host did not accept any of these keys:
connectError.authorizedKeysHint: Add the public key to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys of $user on $host.
connectError.noKeys: No key to offer $host. Add one to the ssh-agent with ssh-add, or name it with IdentityFile in ~/.ssh/config.

tailscale.title: Tailscale devices
tailscale.notInstalled: Tailscale is not installed on this computer.
tailscale.noPeers: No other devices in this tailnet.

transfer.exportBody: $count SSH machines with their jump hosts and trusted host keys. Private keys, passphrases and passwords are never exported.
transfer.exportNone: There are no SSH machines to export.
transfer.importHint: Paste an export from another device, or choose its file.
transfer.hostKeysBody: The import holds host keys that would change which servers this device trusts. Trust a host's keys only if you know they are right; the others are not imported.

settings.aboutClient: A client for omp, the oh-my-pi coding agent

themeEditor.title: Custom theme
themeEditor.terminalNote: The terminal draws these as they are; command output in the chat keeps their hue at its own contrast.

uses(map).selected: Hover, selected rows, focused fields, tab indicators
uses(map).accent: Primary buttons, switches that are on, progress
uses(map).onAccent: Text and icons on the accent
uses(map).title: Function names, titles, links

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.desktopDetail: About the sessions open here, while you are in another window or session
notifications.pushDetail: From your machines, while this phone is not in the session
notifications.pushLost: Turned off: this phone no longer has its notification key, as after a restore from a backup. Turn them on again.
notifications.testNone: Connect to a machine to send a test notification.
notifications.denied: Notifications are turned off for ompanion in the system settings.
notifications.registrationFailed: Push notifications on $machine could not be updated: $error
notifications.unknownMachine: That notification came from a machine that is no longer in ompanion.
notifications.subtitle: $machine · $kind

sessions.runningOnMachine: Open in omp on the machine
sessions.noFolderHint: omp works in a temporary directory, as when it starts in the home folder. The session lists right under the machine.
sessions.noTempDirectory: None of omp's temporary directories ($paths) is a directory on $machine.
sessions.directoryHint: A path on the machine, e.g. ~/code/project
sessions.modelUseDefault: Use the model from omp's settings

install.title: Install omp on $machine
install.viaDownload: The machine downloads this release from GitHub and checks its SHA-256 before installing it.
install.viaUpload: The machine has neither curl nor wget: the app downloads the release here and uploads it, checking its SHA-256 on the machine.
install.installing: Downloading and installing on the machine…

chat.noThinking: This model has no thinking levels.
chat.thinkingFailed: Could not change the thinking level: $error
chat.contextUnknown: Context usage not known yet · cost $cost
chat.noCompanion: The companion is not loaded in this session, so pause, queue editing, shell or Python runs, goals and loops are unavailable.
chat.stopSessionFailed: Could not stop the omp process: $error
chat.idleExitedDetail: Sending a message starts it again.
chat.parked: Paused: the run waits before its next step
chat.fallbackApplied: Switched from $from to the fallback model $to. $reason
chat.cannotBranch: Branching is only possible from your own messages.
chat.branchBody:
A new session file starts before this message, and the message goes back into the composer:

$text
chat.resetKept: Earlier replies are kept in the session tree.
chat.replaceDraftBody: Reset to here puts this message back into the composer. The text and attachments you have not sent are lost.

attachments.missing: $name is no longer on this device. Nothing was sent.
attachments.tooLarge: $name is $size; attachments can be at most $limit. Nothing was sent.
attachments.folder: $name is a folder. Folders can be attached only to sessions on this computer. Nothing was sent.
attachments.needsCompanion: $name needs the companion to reach the session's machine, and this session has none. Nothing was sent.
attachments.uploadFailed: $name could not be copied to the session's machine: $error. Nothing was sent.

composer.dropNothing: Only files and folders can be attached.
composer.unknownCommand: /$name is not a command of this session. Nothing was sent.
composer.externalBody: Another omp process is writing this session file. ompanion reads its transcript live, but sending is off: two writers would overwrite each other. Messages queued in that process are not visible here.
composer.externalWait: The other omp process still owns this session. Take it over once it has exited.
composer.externalGone: The other omp process has stopped
composer.externalBodyGone: The other omp process is gone. Take the session over to send messages from here.

goal.label: Goal $usage
goal.budgetInvalid: Goal budget must be a positive integer or `off`.
goal.dropBody: This removes the goal record. Accumulated usage stays in the session log.

loop.whileLabel: Goes on while this command succeeds:
loop.untilLabel: Goes on until this command succeeds:
loop.waitingPrompt: Waiting for your next prompt, which it repeats after every turn.
loop.pausedPrompt: Suspended. The next prompt you send resumes it.

requests.forwarding: Forwarding localhost:$port on this device to the machine for the login callback.
requests.forwardFailed: Could not forward the login callback port: $error
requests.unsupportedBody: The companion asked for "$method", which this app version cannot show.
requests.notWebLink: Not an http or https link, so it does not open from here.

ask.title: Question
ask.invalid: The question could not be read: $error

transcript.resetRunning: Wait for the turn to finish, or stop it, before resetting
transcript.lengthLimit: Stopped at the output token limit.
transcript.retrySuperseded: This attempt failed; retrying gave up after attempt $attempt.
transcript.retryFailed: This attempt failed; retry $attempt failed too.
transcript.imageUnsupported: $path ($size) is in a format this app cannot show
transcript.imageTooLarge: $path ($size) is too large to load on its own
transcript.branchSummary: Summary of the branch you left

config.title: Configure $machine
config.needsOmp: omp needs an install or an upgrade on this machine: $reason

scope.projectNone: Open a session on this machine to edit its project settings.

provenance.envHint: The environment variable $name overrides the files.
provenance.runtimeHint: Set for this omp process only (RPC mode or a runtime override); the app's sessions use it.
provenance.overlayHint: Forced by the app's per-session config overlay.
provenance.defaultsHint: omp's default; no file sets it.

settings.advancedNote: Settings without a row in omp's settings panel, grouped by their first key.
settings.themeNote: These are omp's terminal UI settings. The app's own look follows the app settings.
settings.secretHelp: Sent to the machine as a private file that omp reads and deletes; never shown or logged.
settings.secretGlobalOnly: Credentials are saved in the global config only.

roles.storage: omp's model picker saves roles to: $storage
roles.noProject: Open a session on this machine to assign project roles.
roles.useTypedHint: A model omp does not list as available here

accounts.sessionView: In use and pinned marks refer to the session in $path.
accounts.logoutBody: The stored credential for $provider is removed from this machine.
accounts.oauthLocal: The browser opens on this computer.
accounts.oauthRemote: The browser opens on this device; the app forwards omp's callback port to the machine.
accounts.openLink: Open this link and sign in:
accounts.forwarding: Forwarding local port $ports to the machine for the callback.
accounts.forwardFailed: Could not forward port $port ($error). Paste the redirect URL when omp asks for it.
accounts.bootstrap: No model works on this machine yet. Sign in with an account or add an API key; settings and roles work meanwhile.
accounts.otherNote: Stores a key under a provider id this list does not show, as models.yml or an extension names it.

source.runtime: omp uses a key set for this omp process only.
source.config: omp uses the key that models.yml sets.
source.apiKey: omp uses a stored API key.
source.env: omp uses the key in the environment variable $name.
source.working: omp has a working credential for this provider.

overridden.config: models.yml sets a key for this provider, so omp uses that key and not the stored one.
overridden.env: The environment variable $name sets a key, so omp uses it and not the stored one.
overridden.runtime: A key set for this omp process wins over the stored one.

mcp.removeBody: The server is removed from the $scope mcp.json.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.nameInvalid: Only letters, digits, - _ . : and single spaces
mcp.tokenHint: Written into the user mcp.json as an Authorization header.
mcp.tokenUserOnly: Only user-scope servers take a token here: a project session would keep it in its run log.
mcp.tuiOnly: omp 18.3.1 offers reauth, unauth, reconnect and Smithery login only in its terminal UI.
mcp.testDisabled: Enable the server to test it; omp loads only enabled servers.

plugins.installHint: An npm package, name@marketplace, github:user/repo, a git URL or a local path. npm installs need bun on the machine.
plugins.sourcePlaceholder: owner/repo, git URL or local path

skills.scriptsBody: Installing it runs its scripts on the machine. Install anyway?
